title: Introduction to Paleontology
description:
S01 E08 — Fossils and the Shifting Crust
Learning why life on Earth is exactly where it is today; understanding why some species are found only in isolated pockets while others are spread across multiple continents; uncovering what fossils tell us about our planet's historic migrations.

title: The Darwinian Revolution
description:
S01 E05 — Theories of Evolution Just Before Darwin
The idea of evolution is in the air; looking at precursors to Darwin, including Jean-Baptiste Lamarck; Lamarck writes a systematic account of the evolution of species over time; he proposes that acquired characteristics can be inherited.

title: The Darwinian Revolution
description:
S01 E06 — Why Evolution Was Rejected Before Darwin
Investigating the dubious status of evolutionary ideas in the years before Darwin's book; one objection is that evolution challenges the Bible and lacks convincing empirical support; some critics even class evolution with fringe ideas.

title: The Darwinian Revolution
description:
S01 E07 — Darwin's Conversion to Evolution
A young Darwin's intention to join the ministry is interrupted by an offer to travel around the world as a naturalist aboard HMS Beagle; the experience changes his life, giving him a growing conviction that species have altered over time.

title: The Darwinian Revolution
description:
S01 E08 — What's in On the Origin of Species?
Darwin spends two decades developing his theory of evolution; how he is rushed to publish prematurely by the independent discovery of the same principle by Alfred Russel Wallace; "On the Origin of Species" is a masterful statement of his idea.

title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
description:
S01 E01 — Reflections On and of Pompeii
When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm.

title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
description:
S01 E02 — Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area.

title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
description:
S01 E03 — The Rediscovery of Vesuvian Lands
Archeological finds from the area are unearthed starting around 1594; uncovering the history of Pompeii's excavation in the 1700s, from the kings who plunder its artwork to the modern scholars who seek another kind of treasure.

title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
description:
S01 E04 — Etruscan Pompeii - 5th Century B.C.
While the last days of Pompeii attract popular attention, the city is a thriving cultural center centuries before its destruction; delving deep into Pompeii's remote Etruscan history; exploring what life is like in this ancient pre-Roman settlement.

title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
description:
S01 E05 — Samnite Pompeii - 2nd Century B.C.
Centuries after the establishment of Etruscan Pompeii, the city is invaded by the Samnites; witnessing the conquest of the city by these invaders; considering how Pompeii is redefined and expanded by its new inhabitants.

title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
description:
S01 E01 — A Destination Like No Other
A look at two of Ireland's most iconic tourist spots, the Rock of Cashel and the Guinness Brewery; these sites represent a microcosm of Ireland's story; an introduction to the people and the landscape of the Emerald Isle; a preview of the grand tour.

title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
description:
S01 E02 — Prehistoric and Celtic Ireland
Investigating the origins of civilization in Ireland; visiting several ancient sites, including Newgrange and the great Hill of Tara; what the ruins say about the Celtic people, their religion and some of the myths of Irish history.

title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
description:
S01 E03 — Early Christian and Medieval Ireland
St. Patrick is one of the greatest figures in Irish history, linked to the story of both the island and Christianity; visiting several important sites that include Croagh Patrick, St. Patrick's Cathedral and the Clonmacnoise monastery.

title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
description:
S01 E04 — Ireland during the Protestant Ascendancy
Irish history's entanglement with Great Britain; from the Norman castles to the battlefield of Aughrim, the Irish landscape is imbued with relics of British imperialism; exploring the British-Irish divide, which is also a Catholic-Protestant divide.

title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
description:
S01 E05 — From the Easter Rising to the Present Day
An exploration of the 20th century; stops on the tour include the general post office in Dublin, which plays a role in the 1916 uprising; the town of Derry, home of the Bloody Sunday tragedy; a typical modern farmhouse in the Irish countryside.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E01 — Pacific Crest Trail
Exploring the Pacific Crest Trail, an extraordinary route that stretches 2,650 miles from the deserts of Southern California on the Mexico border all the way to the Canadian border in Washington.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E02 — Hayduke Trail
Mick journeys along the hazardous 800-mile backcountry route of the Hayduke Trail.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E03 — Pacific Northwest Trail
Traveling one of the most scenic and rugged long-distance trails in the world: the 1,200-mile Pacific Northwest Trail.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E04 — Continental Divide Trail
At 3,100 miles, the Continental Divide Trail is the second-longest National Scenic Trail in the United States, and arguably the most rugged, remote, and hazardous of them all.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E05 — Great Allegheny Passage
Exploring a predominantly flat hiking trail from Pennsylvania's Pittsburgh to Maryland's Cumberland.

title: America's Great Trails
description:
S01 E06 — Appalachian Trail
Checking out the world's longest hiking trail, located in North America.
